new_results.statement: For every measurable K:R^n->[0,1], the supremum of int K prod_i f_i over independent densities 0<=f_i<=1 of mass 1 equals the supremum over product indicators 1_{E_i} with |E_i|=1.
The same supremum is unchanged if each E_i is a bounded finite union of intervals of total measure 1; no constant loss.
For the quadratic fiber h(x)=1_{R^2<=x^2<=R^2+epsilon}, a disconnected unit-measure support captures twice the slab length of any unit interval once R>1 and 2(sqrt(R^2+epsilon)-R)<1.
